d.ko: Wildermyth follows heroes over their whole careers, from their pitchfork days to their powerful primes, and on into old age and memory. It’s a party-based procedural storytelling RPG where tactical combat and story decisions will alter your world and reshape your cast of characters.
d.en: Wildermyth follows heroes over their whole careers, from their pitchfork days to their powerful primes, and on into old age and memory. It’s a party-based procedural storytelling RPG where tactical combat and story decisions will alter your world and reshape your cast of characters.
d.zh: 《漫野奇谭（Wildermyth）》是一款可以自己编撰传奇的策略RPG。塑造独一无二的角色，并让他们在策略丰富的战斗中磨练，在抉择众多的故事中成长。
